Ionian Boots of Lucidity

900 goldBoots

Cheap boots with ability haste (lower ability cooldowns) and summoner spell haste (Flash and others come back sooner).

Stats

  • 10 Ability Haste
  • 45 Move Speed

What it does

Ionian Insight: Gain 10 Summoner Spell Haste.

When to buy it

Buy them on champions who want to cast abilities more often, and when the enemy has no threat that needs defensive boots.
